''See also: [[Elder Whisper Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Elder Whisper is an ancient [[sacred beast]] and a foundational figure of the [[Wei clan]]. Having joined the original clan founders to establish the [[Wei clan]] in [[Sacred Valley]], he played a significant role in dominating local [[Remnants]] and assimilating smaller clans. He is the creator and original master of the [[Path of the White Fox]], a signature clan [[technique]] that utilizes [[madra]] to manipulate light and sound to create illusions and deceive the senses. As a massive, [[five-tailed snowfox]], he possesses the ability to manifest multiple illusory reflections of himself simultaneously. Beyond his martial contributions, the elder has developed a limited ability to perceive glimpses of Fate{{!}}fate through his [[dreams]]. He resides in a tall tower and possesses knowledge regarding the ancient origins of labyrinth{{!}}the labyrinth and methods for defeating the [[Dreadgods]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Elder Whisper is an ancient sacred [[snowfox]] characterized by white fur and five bushy tails. This creature possesses a single jet-black eye.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|An elder of the [[Wei clan]], this fox is considered untrustworthy. He has spent a century meditating on the nature of [[dreams]] and possesses a sense for Fate{{!}}fate.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|As the original master of the [[Path of the White Fox]], he harvests light and [[dreams]] into his core. His powers include a cloak of invisibility that allows him to visit [[Heaven's Glory]] unseen.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Observing the Labyrinth}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Elder Whisper is a white fox who serves as an elder within [[Lindon]]'s clan.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c2">''Reaper'', chapter 2</ref> For several years, this individual has maintained the opening of the [[Sword Sage]]’s private [[void space]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c2" /> Possessing the ability to observe labyrinth{{!}}the labyrinth door, this untrustworthy fox believes that another person might be present inside labyrinth{{!}}the labyrinth.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c3">''Reaper'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c6">''Reaper'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c10">''Reaper'', chapter 10</ref>}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|“The Sage brought this to our lands,” Elder Whisper continued,<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c22" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|“Whisper is one of the elders of my clan,” Lindon said, gesturing to the fox behind him.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|“And yet…” Lindon began, but he cut the sentence off before he said, “And yet you held the Sword Sage’s private void space open for years.”<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|“Elder Whisper, we believe there may be someone else in the labyrinth,” Lindon said.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c10" />}}
